About

I’m based in Nigeria and I’m building my career online. I learn by building real things: a bot that collects orders for a food business, a loan tracker that sends reminders, a reporting system for a construction company.

I use n8n to connect the tools people already use, like Telegram and Google Sheets, so information moves on its own and the owner sees what matters.

Right now

  • Building an automated operational reporting system in stages
  • Learning more about error handling and AI steps inside workflows
  • Making short videos about what I learn in automation

How I work

1

Understand the task

You tell me what you do by hand today and what a good result looks like.

2

Build a first version

I build a working version in n8n, starting with the smallest useful part.

3

Test and improve

We run it with real data, fix what breaks and adjust until it fits how you work.
